title: The Evolution of Coordination in a Collective Intelligence System: 25 Years of English Wikipedia and the Emergence of Generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.16856v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: English Wikipedia is one of the largest examples of collective intelligence on the Web, sustained not only by article production but also by volunteer coordination and governance. While prior research has examined coordination work in Wikipedia, less attention has been paid to how participation in these spaces has evolved over time. Drawing on a longitudinal analysis spanning nearly 25 years of English Wikipedia, we examine editing patterns across five namespaces covering content, discussion, and governance. We find that participation in coordination spaces has declined relative to content production, particularly in governance areas, with a shrinking core of editors performing an increasing share of this work. Using Markov-based session metrics, we also find that editing has become more specialised, with editors moving less frequently between namespaces. translated_title: 集体智能系统中协调的演变：英语维基百科的25年与生成式人工智能的兴起
translated_abstract: 英语维基百科是网络上集体智能的最大范例之一，它不仅依靠条目生产来维持，还依靠志愿者的协调与治理。虽然以往的研究考察了维基百科中的协调工作，但对参与这些空间的方式如何随时间演变却关注较少。通过对英语维基百科近25年的纵向分析，我们考察了涵盖内容、讨论和治理五个命名空间的编辑模式。我们发现，相对于内容生产，协调空间的参与有所下降，尤其是在治理领域，由一个不断缩小的核心编辑群体承担了越来越多的此类工作。使用基于马尔可夫模型的会话指标，我们还发现编辑工作变得更加专业化，编辑者在不同命名空间之间移动的频率降低了。受近期围绕生成式人工智能的治理辩论的启发，我们最后调查了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对英语维基百科近25年的纵向分析发现，协调性参与（尤其是治理领域）相对于内容生产持续下降，编辑工作日益集中于不断缩小的核心编辑群体，且编辑行为变得更加专业化。
en_tdlr: A nearly 25-year longitudinal analysis of English Wikipedia shows that participation in coordination spaces, particularly governance, has declined relative to content production, with a shrinking core of increasingly specialized editors performing a growing share of this work.
